label: Coordinate and compressed sparse row formats
section: Coordinate and compressed sparse row formats
subgoals: Count one triple per nonzero for COO
Size val and col_idx at nnz and row_ptr at n + 1
Choose CSC for column-oriented factorization and CSR for row products

label: Reading the row pointer
subgoals: Count the nonzeros in each row
Take the prefix sum starting from zero
Read row i as the half-open range from row_ptr[i] to row_ptr[i+1]

label: Memory cost against dense storage
subgoals: Charge 12 bytes per nonzero plus 4 bytes per row pointer
Compare with 8 n squared bytes for dense storage
Switch to 64-bit indices once nnz exceeds the 32-bit range
